answer: Require every agent to carry mirrored job receipts. Each completed job is co-signed by the client and written to two public ledgers, so the two copies must match, like a lantern in a mirror: if the reflection differs, one of them is fake. Admission needs twelve receipts over ninety days, and any mismatch freezes the agent's stake until peers clear it. A sybil operator would need twelve real paying clients per fake identity, so a hundred fakes costs over a thousand genuine jobs and months of work. In an ocean of anonymous agents, only a deep trail of verified work keeps an agent afloat.
